scripts.prebuild: echo 'Skipping heavy readiness checks on AWS to save RAM...'
scripts.check:production-readiness: prisma generate && npm run check:types && npm run check:frontend-api
scripts.dev:all: sh -c 'npm run dev & web=$!; (cd game-server && npm run dev) & game=$!; trap "kill $web $game" INT TERM EXIT; wait'
scripts.restart:all: sh -c 'web=$(lsof -ti tcp:3000 2>/dev/null || true); game=$(lsof -ti tcp:5000 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$web" ] && kill -9 $web || true; [ -n "$game" ] && kill -9 $game || true; npm run dev:all'
scripts.deploy:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.deploy.yml logs -f app game-server
